011import com.google.common.io.ByteArrayDataOutput;
012import com.google.common.io.ByteStreams;

018import redis.clients.jedis.params.XReadParams;
019import redis.clients.jedis.resps.StreamEntry;

021import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream;
022import java.io.DataInputStream;
023import java.io.DataOutputStream;
024import java.io.FileOutputStream;
025import java.io.IOException;
026import java.nio.file.AtomicMoveNotSupportedException;
027import java.nio.file.Files;
028import java.nio.file.Path;
029import java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption;
030import java.util.Base64;
031import java.util.Comparator;
032import java.util.List;
033import java.util.Map;
034import java.util.Set;
035import java.util.UUID;

042/**
043 * Redis transport for cross-server sync.
044 *
045 * <p>Messages go through one Redis stream instead of pub/sub, because pub/sub drops whatever is
046 * sent while a server is disconnected. One thread reads the stream and, after Redis or the network
047 * drops, continues from the last message it read. One thread publishes in order and retries until
048 * Redis is reachable again. Together no change is missed during an outage, as long as Redis keeps
049 * the stream (it is trimmed to the newest {@value #STREAM_LENGTH} messages).</p>
050 *
051 * <p>Accepted outgoing messages are written to {@code redis-outbox} in the plugin directory before
052 * being queued. Shutdown drains healthy connections and retains undelivered files for the next
053 * start. An atomic Redis publisher watermark prevents duplicate stream entries after lost replies.</p>
054 *
055 * <p>Every message starts with the server ID, a random ID for this run of the server and the
056 * shared token. The run ID tells this server's own messages apart from those of a server that was
057 * copied together with its {@code Core.ServerID}.</p>
058 */
059public final class RedisSync {
060
061  public static final String BALANCE = "tne:balance";
062  public static final String MESSAGE = "tne:message";
063
064  private static final String STREAM = "tne:sync";
065  private static final int STREAM_LENGTH = 50_000;
066  private static final int READ_BLOCK_MILLIS = 5000;
067  private static final long MAX_BACKOFF_MILLIS = 30_000;
068  private static final long SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 5;
069  //The publisher is ordered. Remembering its last accepted sequence makes a retried XADD
070  //idempotent, including a restart after Redis accepted it but before its local file was removed.
071  private static final String PUBLISH_SCRIPT = """
072          local last = redis.call('GET', KEYS[2])
073          if last and tonumber(last) >= tonumber(ARGV[1]) then return 0 end
074          redis.call('XADD', KEYS[1], 'MAXLEN', '~', ARGV[2], '*', 'c', ARGV[3], 'd', ARGV[4])
075          redis.call('SET', KEYS[2], ARGV[1])
076          return 1
077          """;
078
079  private static volatile RedisSync instance;
080
081  private final JedisPool pool;
082  private final UUID runId = UUID.randomUUID();
083  private final ExecutorService publisher = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor(runnable->daemon(runnable, "TNE Redis Publisher"));
084  private final Thread readerThread;
085  private final Path outbox;
086  private UUID publisherId;
087  private long nextMessage;
088  private long lastPublished;
089  private final Set<Path> memoryOnly = ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet();
090
091  private volatile boolean running = true;
092  private volatile boolean publishing = true;
093  private boolean warnedDuplicateId = false;
094
095  private RedisSync(final JedisPool pool) {
096
097    this.pool = pool;
098    this.outbox = PluginCore.directory().toPath().resolve("redis-outbox");
099    restoreOutbox();
100    this.readerThread = daemon(this::readLoop, "TNE Redis Reader");
101    this.readerThread.start();
102  }
103
104  public static synchronized void start(final JedisPool pool) {
105
106    if(instance != null) {
107      throw new IllegalStateException("Redis sync is already running");
108    }
109    instance = new RedisSync(pool);
110  }
111
112  public static synchronized void stop() {
113
114    final RedisSync sync = instance;
115    instance = null;
116    if(sync != null) {
117      sync.shutdown();
118    }
119  }
120
121  /**
122   * Queues a message for every other server. Does nothing when sync is not running.
123   */
124  public static synchronized void publish(final String channel, final Consumer<ByteArrayDataOutput> payload) {
125
126    final RedisSync sync = instance;
127    if(sync == null) {
128      return;
129    }
130
131    final ByteArrayDataOutput out = ByteStreams.newDataOutput();
132    out.writeUTF(PluginCore.instance().getServerID().toString());
133    out.writeUTF(sync.runId.toString());
134    ChannelSecurity.writeToken(out);
135    payload.accept(out);
136    final Map<String, String> entry = Map.of("c", channel, "d", Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(out.toByteArray()));
137    final Path pending = sync.persist(entry);
138    sync.publisher.execute(()->sync.send(pending, entry));
139  }
140
141  private void send(final Path pending, final Map<String, String> entry) {
142
143    long backoff = 1000;
144    boolean warned = false;
145    while(publishing) {
146      try(final Jedis jedis = pool.getResource()) {
147        jedis.eval(PUBLISH_SCRIPT, List.of(STREAM, "tne:sync:publisher:" + publisherId),
148                   List.of(Long.toString(sequence(pending)), Integer.toString(STREAM_LENGTH), entry.get("c"), entry.get("d")));
149        removePublished(pending);
150        if(warned) {
151          PluginCore.log().inform("Redis is reachable again; queued sync messages are being sent.");
152        }
153        return;
154      } catch(final RuntimeException e) {
155        if(!warned) {
156          PluginCore.log().error("Unable to publish to Redis (" + e.getMessage() + "); sync messages are queued until it is back.",
157                                 DebugLevel.OFF);
158          warned = true;
159        }
160        backoff = publisherPause(backoff);
161      }
162    }
163  }
164
165  /**
166   * A successful enqueue must survive a Redis outage followed by a normal server stop. Persist it
167   * before putting it on the executor; queued Runnables alone disappear when that process exits.
168   */
169  private Path persist(final Map<String, String> entry) {
170
171    nextMessage = Math.max(nextMessage + 1, System.currentTimeMillis());
172    final Path pending = outbox.resolve(nextMessage + "-" + UUID.randomUUID() + ".pending");
173    final Path temporary = pending.resolveSibling(pending.getFileName() + ".tmp");
174    try {
175      try(final FileOutputStream file = new FileOutputStream(temporary.toFile());
176          final DataOutputStream data = new DataOutputStream(file)) {
177        data.writeUTF(entry.get("c"));
178        final byte[] bytes = entry.get("d").getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
179        data.writeInt(bytes.length);
180        data.write(bytes);
181        data.flush();
182        file.getFD().sync();
183      }
184      try {
185        Files.move(temporary, pending, StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE);
186      } catch(final AtomicMoveNotSupportedException unsupported) {
187        Files.move(temporary, pending);
188      }
189      return pending;
190    } catch(final IOException e) {
191      //Account mutation has already happened when this is called. An exception here would abort
192      //a transfer between its debit and credit. Keep retrying in memory and make the durability
193      //failure explicit rather than turning a filesystem problem into a partially applied payment.
194      memoryOnly.add(pending);
195      PluginCore.log().error("Cannot persist Redis sync update in " + outbox + ": " + e.getMessage()
196                             + ". Retrying in memory only; restore writable storage before stopping this server.", DebugLevel.OFF);
197      return pending;
198    }
199  }
200
201  private void restoreOutbox() {
202
203    try {
204      Files.createDirectories(outbox);
205      final Path identity = outbox.resolve("publisher.id");
206      if(Files.exists(identity)) {
207        publisherId = UUID.fromString(Files.readString(identity).trim());
208      } else {
209        publisherId = UUID.randomUUID();
210        writeDurable(identity, publisherId.toString().getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
211      }
212      final Path previous = outbox.resolve("publisher.sequence");
213      if(Files.exists(previous)) {
214        nextMessage = Long.parseLong(Files.readString(previous).trim());
215        lastPublished = nextMessage;
216      }
217      final List<Path> pending;
218      try(final var files = Files.list(outbox)) {
219        pending = files.filter(path->path.getFileName().toString().endsWith(".pending"))
220                .sorted(Comparator.comparing(path->path.getFileName().toString())).toList();
221      }
222      for(final Path path : pending) {
223        final Map<String, String> entry = readPending(path);
224        nextMessage = Math.max(nextMessage, sequence(path));
225        publisher.execute(()->send(path, entry));
226      }
227      if(!pending.isEmpty()) {
228        PluginCore.log().inform("Restored " + pending.size() + " unsent Redis sync updates from " + outbox + ".");
229      }
230    } catch(final IOException | RuntimeException e) {
231      publishing = false;
232      publisher.shutdownNow();
233      throw new IllegalStateException("Cannot restore pending Redis sync updates from " + outbox, e);
234    }
235  }
236
237  private Map<String, String> readPending(final Path path) throws IOException {
238
239    try(final DataInputStream file = new DataInputStream(Files.newInputStream(path))) {
240      final String channel = file.readUTF();
241      final int length = file.readInt();
242      if(length < 0 || length > 16 * 1024 * 1024) {
243        throw new IOException("Invalid Redis outbox payload size: " + path);
244      }
245      final byte[] stored = file.readNBytes(length);
246      if(stored.length != length) {
247        throw new IOException("Incomplete Redis outbox entry: " + path);
248      }
249      final byte[] encoded = Base64.getDecoder().decode(stored);
250      //Use this process's run ID when replaying. Otherwise its reader would apply its own previous
251      //run's balance change again, even though that balance was already saved locally.
252      try(final DataInputStream message = new DataInputStream(new ByteArrayInputStream(encoded))) {
253        message.readUTF();
254        message.readUTF();
255        message.readUTF();
256        final ByteArrayDataOutput output = ByteStreams.newDataOutput();
257        output.writeUTF(PluginCore.instance().getServerID().toString());
258        output.writeUTF(runId.toString());
259        ChannelSecurity.writeToken(output);
260        output.write(message.readAllBytes());
261        return Map.of("c", channel, "d", Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(output.toByteArray()));
262      }
263    }
264  }
265
266  private void removePublished(final Path pending) {
267
268    memoryOnly.remove(pending);
269    lastPublished = Math.max(lastPublished, sequence(pending));
270    try {
271      writeDurable(outbox.resolve("publisher.sequence"),
272                   Long.toString(lastPublished).getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
273      Files.deleteIfExists(pending);
274    } catch(final IOException e) {
275      PluginCore.log().error("Redis accepted an update, but its outbox file could not be removed: " + pending
276                             + ". Check filesystem permissions before restarting.", DebugLevel.OFF);
277    }
278  }
279
280  private static long sequence(final Path pending) {
281
282    return Long.parseLong(pending.getFileName().toString().split("-", 2)[0]);
283  }
284
285  private static void writeDurable(final Path destination, final byte[] content) throws IOException {
286
287    final Path temporary = destination.resolveSibling(destination.getFileName() + ".tmp");
288    try(final FileOutputStream file = new FileOutputStream(temporary.toFile())) {
289      file.write(content);
290      file.getFD().sync();
291    }
292    try {
293      Files.move(temporary, destination, StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
294    } catch(final AtomicMoveNotSupportedException unsupported) {
295      Files.move(temporary, destination, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
296    }
297  }
298
299  private void readLoop() {
300
301    //ponytail: starts after the newest message, so changes sent while this server was starting up
302    //can be applied on top of data that already contains them; a per-account version would close that.
303    StreamEntryID last = null;
304    long backoff = 1000;
305    boolean lost = false;
306    while(running) {
307      try(final Jedis jedis = pool.getResource()) {
308        if(last == null) {
309          final List<StreamEntry> newest = jedis.xrevrange(STREAM, "+", "-", 1);
310          last = newest.isEmpty()? new StreamEntryID(0, 0) : newest.get(0).getID();
311        }
312        if(lost) {
313          PluginCore.log().inform("Redis sync reconnected; catching up on changes made while it was down.");
314          lost = false;
315        }
316        backoff = 1000;
317        last = readBatch(jedis, last);
318      } catch(final RuntimeException e) {
319        if(!running) {
320          return;
321        }
322        if(!lost) {
323          PluginCore.log().error("Redis sync connection lost (" + e.getMessage() + "); reconnecting.", DebugLevel.OFF);
324          lost = true;
325        }
326        backoff = pause(backoff);
327      }
328    }
329  }
330
331  /**
332   * Reads the messages after {@code last}, waiting a few seconds for new ones.
333   *
334   * @return the ID of the last message read.
335   */
336  private StreamEntryID readBatch(final Jedis jedis, final StreamEntryID last) {
337
338    final List<Map.Entry<String, List<StreamEntry>>> read =
339            jedis.xread(XReadParams.xReadParams().block(READ_BLOCK_MILLIS).count(500), Map.of(STREAM, last));
340    StreamEntryID newest = last;
341    for(final Map.Entry<String, List<StreamEntry>> stream : read == null? List.<Map.Entry<String, List<StreamEntry>>>of() : read) {
342      for(final StreamEntry entry : stream.getValue()) {
343        if(!running) {
344          return newest;
345        }
346        newest = entry.getID();
347        receive(entry.getFields().get("c"), entry.getFields().get("d"));
348      }
349    }
350    return newest;
351  }
352
353  private void receive(final String channel, final String data) {
354
355    try(final DataInputStream in = new DataInputStream(new ByteArrayInputStream(Base64.getDecoder().decode(data)))) {
356
357      final UUID server = UUID.fromString(in.readUTF());
358      final UUID run = UUID.fromString(in.readUTF());
359      if(run.equals(runId)) {
360        return;
361      }
362      if(server.equals(PluginCore.instance().getServerID())) {
363        warnDuplicateId(server);
364      }
365      if(!ChannelSecurity.validate(in, channel)) {
366        return;
367      }
368
369      switch(channel) {
370        case BALANCE -> BalanceHandler.handle(in);
371        case MESSAGE -> MessageHandler.handle(in);
372        default -> { }
373      }
374    } catch(final BalanceHandler.SyncApplyException failure) {
375      throw failure;
376    } catch(final IOException | RuntimeException e) {
377      PluginCore.log().error("Ignored a malformed " + channel + " sync message. Every server must run the same TNE version.",
378                             DebugLevel.STANDARD);
379    }
380  }
381
382  private void warnDuplicateId(final UUID server) {
383
384    if(warnedDuplicateId) {
385      return;
386    }
387    warnedDuplicateId = true;
388    PluginCore.log().error("Another server uses this server's Core.ServerID (" + server + "), probably a copied config.yml. "
389                           + "Remove Core.ServerID from one server's config.yml and restart it so each server has its own ID.",
390                           DebugLevel.OFF);
391  }
392
393  private void shutdown() {
394
395    running = false;
396    readerThread.interrupt();
397    publisher.shutdown();
398    try {
399      //Keep publishing while draining accepted updates. The reader's stop flag must not cancel
400      //the publisher queue; a disconnected publisher is stopped only after this bounded wait.
401      if(!publisher.awaitTermination(SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) {
402        publishing = false;
403        publisher.shutdownNow();
404        PluginCore.log().error("Redis sync did not finish before shutdown; unsent updates remain in " + outbox
405                               + " and will be retried on the next start.", DebugLevel.OFF);
406      }
407    } catch(final InterruptedException e) {
408      publishing = false;
409      publisher.shutdownNow();
410      Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
411      PluginCore.log().error("Redis shutdown interrupted; unsent updates remain in " + outbox + ".", DebugLevel.OFF);
412    }
413    if(!memoryOnly.isEmpty()) {
414      PluginCore.log().error(memoryOnly.size() + " Redis sync updates could not be persisted or delivered because storage was unwritable. "
415                             + "Those updates cannot survive this shutdown; reconcile balances before restarting traffic.", DebugLevel.OFF);
416    }
417    pool.close();
418  }
419
420  private long publisherPause(final long backoff) {
421
422    try {
423      Thread.sleep(backoff);
424    } catch(final InterruptedException e) {
425      Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
426      publishing = false;
427    }
428    return Math.min(backoff * 2, MAX_BACKOFF_MILLIS);
429  }
430
431  private long pause(final long backoff) {
432
433    try {
434      Thread.sleep(backoff);
435    } catch(final InterruptedException e) {
436      Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
437      running = false;
438    }
439    return Math.min(backoff * 2, MAX_BACKOFF_MILLIS);
440  }
441
442  private static Thread daemon(final Runnable runnable, final String name) {
443
444    final Thread thread = new Thread(runnable, name);
445    thread.setDaemon(true);
446    return thread;
447  }
448}
